d: Bihar ke mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri rajdhani patna sthit hotal taj siti sentar men aayojit 'levrejing FTAs – aautrich program, bihar' (Leveraging FTAs – Outreach Programme, Bihar) men shamil hue. is karyakram ke dauran mukhyamantri ne rajy men udyogon ko barhava dene, niryat barhane aur nae vyavsayik avasron ke srijan ko lekar apna bayan diya.
